means: Eyes opened wider than rest, lid lifted clear of the iris - the drawn signature of shock, alarm or awe.
does: Enlarges the visible iris and raises the upper lid, and drags the rest of the face toward alarm with it. It works precisely because it names a drawn FEATURE instead of a feeling: this project measured that the word 'shocked' on its own is routinely ignored, while wide-eyed plus parted lips plus sweat renders shock every time. That is the general lesson for this whole family - stack physical tags, never ask for the emotion by name. Its reach is bounded by shot size: outside a medium close-up the eyes are too few pixels for it to register at all.
reach_for_it: reaction close-ups, always as part of a stack of physical tags and never as the only carrier of an emotion
used_in: prompts/anime_reaction_close.json, which carries a rendered sample; the eyes field of emotions/awe, panic, rage and shock. It appears nowhere in the film JSONs directly - it reaches the prompt through the emotion preset, expanded by compile.py
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short black hair, dark jacket, standing on a rooftop, city skyline behind, late afternoon sun, looking away, masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, absurdres
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
